name: Format robustness eval v1
description: Runs all 30 items of eval-format-v1 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.

eval.notes: The cheapest workload in the suite and a good smoke test before a long run: 30 tiny answers, so it finishes in seconds and catches a broken chat template immediately.

notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
